rationale: The plan maps the question precisely onto the design: a DESeq2 LRT of ~condition + time + condition:time against ~condition + time, with explicit reference levels, printed resultsNames, per-timepoint condition contrasts derived from the single fit rather than subset refits, and a limma-voom/edgeR sensitivity track including a continuous time_hours variant — this is exactly the reference approach and could not be applied to an arbitrary design. QC is present (VST, PCA coloured by condition and shaped by time, sample-distance heatmap, statement of dominant variance source) but omits library-size inspection and any stated policy for an outlier or shallow sample. Filtering (>=10 counts in >=3 samples, applied before the fit, retention reported) and normalization (size factors inside DESeq2, TMM for the voom track, no pre-normalised input) are correct and stated. FDR is BH at a stated alpha with counts at 0.05 and 0.1, though shrinkage is hedged as "where appropriate" and no shrinkage estimator is named; enrichment uses the filtered gene set as universe, human hallmark/GO BP by HGNC symbol, an explicit GSEA signing rule and an underpowered-list contingency, but lacks a collection version and gene-set size window. Reporting names methods, design, thresholds, gene counts and design caveats (baseline t0 differences, omnibus nature of the LRT, modest power with n=3), but does not commit to reporting software versions.
